name: Laguna Niguel Youth Committee
what_you_do: Plan teen events and a youth job fair. You keep lists of youth jobs and volunteer spots. You also help at city events and give the city a teen point of view.
who_can_apply: High school students who live in Laguna Niguel and have a GPA of 2.25 or higher.
pay_detail: The program page does not mention pay.
duration: Two years or until you finish high school. First Thursday of each month, September to May, at 7:00 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026 round ran April 6 to May 1, 2026, closing at 5:00 p.m. Dates for 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the next round opens. The link is on the city recruitment flyer. Questions: YouthCommittee@cityoflagunaniguel.org or (949) 425-5100.
notes: These are last year's dates. The city is taking applications for some other committees through Nov 13, 2026. As of Nov 2, 2026, that list shows no open Youth Committee seat. You can ask the Deputy City Clerk at (949) 362-4302 if a seat opens.
